title: REA synthetic conformance case
description: An offline conformance stimulus and expected observation. A negative derives its fixture from the nominal case in the same directory.

$comment.description: SPDX identifier for this case file.

schema.description: Version of the conformance case envelope.

case.description: Whether the case supplies a nominal fixture or mutates its sibling nominal fixture.

execution_profile.description: Execution profile for this synthetic oracle bank.

fixture.description: Synthetic input data for the indicated test. Field semantics are local to that test.

base_case.description: Sibling fixture used as the mutation base. Resolve it in the current case directory.

mutation.description: One checked replacement within the nominal fixture. The old value must exist and equal from, and to must differ from from.

name.description: Human-readable name of the changed condition.

path.description: JSON Pointer to an existing value strictly below the nominal fixture object.

from.description: Exact JSON value required at path before mutation.

to.description: Exact JSON replacement value used for the negative run.

expected.description: Expected disposition of the tested behaviour and the observations that establish it.

outcome.description: Whether the tested behaviour must be accepted or rejected.

code.description: Oracle-bank diagnostic associated with the expected outcome.

reason.description: Explanation of the acceptance or specific rejection required by the fixture.

assertions.description: Exact comparisons against independently collected observations from the test run.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to a value in the kit's normalized observations.

equals.description: Exact expected JSON value. An absent observation fails the assertion, including when this value is null.
